Sample learner
Choose a subject
Open Library and choose a subject.
Library shows the subjects in your batch. This lesson uses sample lectures only.
Find your lecture
Use the week selector to find a lecture.
Move between weeks or pages to see the available lectures. Locked lectures become available on their scheduled date.
Mark a lecture done
Tap the circle after watching a lecture.
The sample lecture is now marked done. In your tracker, this updates your completed count; tap again to undo it.
Plan a revision
Tap Plan revision to choose when to revise.
Completed lectures can have a revision date. When you finish revising, use Revision done. Nothing is scheduled in this practice.
Choose your study plan
Choose Official or Personal to follow your plan.
Official follows the batch schedule. Personal lets you plan your own watch dates. Changing this lesson does not change your real study mode.
Check your calendar
Open Calendar to see classes and revisions.
Select a day to review what is scheduled. Your own calendar uses the batch timetable and your saved plans.
See your progress
Open Progress to see your completed lectures.
Subject counts help you see what is done and what remains. All counts here are samples.
Add a habit
Tap + New Habit to start.
Create a small routine that you want to repeat. This walkthrough uses a sample habit and saves nothing.
Name your habit
Enter a short habit name.
A clear name makes your daily checklist easy to use. For example, Read for 10 minutes.
Choose repeat days
Choose Every day or Specific days, then Create Habit.
Your habit appears on the days you select. Create Habit saves it in the real screen; this practice only shows a preview.
Mark today done
Tap the check button when you finish.
The sample habit is complete for today. Tap the check again in your real list to undo a mark.
Review your week
Open Weekly to check each day.
The weekly view shows scheduled days and completed habits. Move between weeks to review your routine.
Review your month
Open Month to see your monthly record.
The monthly view helps you see your progress over a longer period. The marks shown here are sample data.
Change a habit
Tap the pencil to change its name or repeat days.
Save Changes updates a habit. Archive removes it from your active routine; permanent deletion removes its records. This practice makes no changes.
Choose a space
Choose Academic or Reflective to explore posts.
Academic is for study discussions; Reflective is for thoughts and experiences. Read the community guidelines before sharing.
Start a post
Tap + to write a post.
Share a question or thought with the community. This practice never publishes anything.
Write your post
Write your question or thought here.
Keep it clear and respectful. The text here is a sample; no one else will see it.
Choose where to share
Choose a space and check Hide my name before sharing.
Turn on Hide my name to share anonymously. Use Share post on the real screen when you are ready to publish.
Join the discussion
Use like, reply, or save on a post.
Likes and replies are visible to others in the real community. Saving keeps a post handy. Practice actions stay local.
Find saved posts
Open Saved to read a post again.
Saved posts appear here. Remove a saved mark when you no longer need it.
Connect with people
Open Connections to manage chat requests.
A chat begins after a request is accepted. Connections may need a Premium plan. This practice sends no requests or messages.
Set your session length
Move the slider to choose your minutes.
Start with a short session that fits your day. The practice timer does not count down or record time.
Start meditating
Tap Play when you are ready.
Play starts your session. Next shows the running controls without starting a real session.
Pause when needed
Tap Pause to take a moment.
After pausing, tap Play to continue the same session. Practice does not count down or play audio.
Start over
Tap Reset to return to the full duration.
Reset returns the timer to your chosen session length. This demonstration does not record a meditation session.
Choose breathing guidance
Open Breathing techniques to choose a pattern.
Choose a breathing pattern that feels comfortable. Follow its inhale, hold, and exhale cues during your session.
Choose session audio
Tap the music icon to open the audio library.
Choose the sound you want for meditation. Guided breathing also has breathing sounds. Practice does not play or save audio.
Use quiet mode
Tap the speaker to mute session audio.
Tap again to hear audio during a real session. Muting changes sound, while Pause stops the timer.
